endorsements.description: In the first full win against the NVIDIS Triton Inference server, Ho Xuan Ninh (@Xuanninh1412) and Tri Dang (@trichimtrich) from Qrious Secure used a four bug chain to exploit #NVIDIA Triton. Their unique work earns them $30,000 and 3 Master of Pwn points.
